'''Leth Outpost''' was a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] military outpost located in the [[Lower Pass]] of [[Highmount Ridge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], at the edge of the ridge and the [[Glacial Fissure]] region. The outpost was an underground bunker with two entrances on the east and west sides.
